Thanks Marissa — quick replies inline and a suggested paragraph for the SSQ.

KMS custody model: we support three configurations: hosted (Redwood-managed CMKs), dedicated (customer-provided CMK via KMS proxy), and HSM-integrated bring-your-own. For SSQ wording I suggest the following short paragraph (ok for external):

"Redwood supports both Redwood-managed key management and customer-managed keys (CMKs). For customers requiring customer-managed keys, Redwood can integrate with customer KMS using envelope encryption with a KMS-proxy pattern; HSM-backed BYOK is supported for Private deployments. Audit logs for master key use are retained in the control plane and can be exported to customer SIEM under contractual terms."

Subprocessor roster: I'll export the canonical roster and redact contact emails. Connor — please confirm the CDN is telemetry-only and that we don't persist PII in edge logs. If that's accurate I'll mark the CDN as "telemetry-only, no PII persisted" in the roster.

Rishi

Sam — thanks for the patience. Please find the attached package to support your vendor review:

- SparrowCare_SSQ_v4.pdf (completed questionnaire; answers reference exhibits).
- redwood_dataflow_v2.png (annotated PII flow with subprocessor handoffs).
- dpa_annex_draft.docx (proposed annex language around telemetry retention and KMS options).

A few highlights/notes:
- KMS: Redwood supports both Redwood-managed keys and customer-managed keys (BYOK). For Private deployments we can integrate an HSM-backed key as requested — see paragraph 3.2 in the draft annex for recommended contract language.
- Subprocessors: attached roster includes compute, storage, analytics, and telemetry partners. The CDN partner is marked as telemetry-only; we do not persist customer PII in edge logs.
- Retention: default telemetry retention is 90 days; PII used for model inputs is only retained when required for troubleshooting and is flagged in the diagram. We included suggested retention carve-outs for regulated data in section 4 of the annex.

Next steps: please confirm whether the attached materials address SparrowCare's audit/SSQ requirements. If you want a redline to the annex, loop in counsel and we'll coordinate — we can also provide exportable audit logs for key events on request under a standard DPA exhibit.

If everything looks good, we can aim to convert the annex to a DocuSign package next week.

Best,
Hannah
